# Icon

Line icons on a 24px grid with a 1.8px round stroke, coloured by currentColor.

`TVTracker.Icon` · Foundations

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.Icon name={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.Icon" name="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (IconProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `IconName` |  |
| `size` | `number` | Pixel size; default 24. |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` |  |
| `filled` | `boolean` | Fill the shape with currentColor (active heart, star). |
